hook: Hang climbers behind another tribe's carry; whenever it grows, they grow too, and your back row finally matters.
loop: Place climbers in back slots behind the front unit you're feeding.
Each End of Turn they Rise with half their host's biggest gain.
Capstones copy gains in full or pour climber stats into the front.

growth.line: Climbers gain half their host's biggest gain each End of Turn; slow early, steep late on big carries.

feel.early: Thin: Dodder Seedling, Ivy Bush and +1/+1 floors.
feel.mid: Arranging hosts; too many climbers for three back slots.
feel.late: Viscum, Hedera and Grand Oak turn gains huge.

stars.why: Copies every host gain in full; drops off if he outgrows it.
Move her behind new tribes' hosts; every host grows per signature.
Repeats the host's biggest gain, and Viscum copies both in full.

builds.name: The Patron
builds.line: One big carry in F2 or F3, fed and copied by climbers.

builds.name: The Season
builds.line: Climbers on three or four tribes; rotate Hedera for signatures.

builds.name: Parasites
builds.line: Dodders steal from enemies, Mistletoe drains hosts, Old Man's Beard inherits.

liked: Viscum and Lady Hedera were every reviewer's standouts: self-limiting, behaviour-based capstones.
Only tribe whose payoff is another tribe's carry; board layout becomes the decision.
worries: Watch Viscum: on an Ooze or Cousin Dodder carry, full copies get huge.
Watch Cousin Dodder's permanent takes and Hedera's +10/+10; thin early turns.
changed: Rise now gives at least +1/+1, so early climbers actually grow.
Viscum copies every host gain in full, but only on your biggest unit.
Woodbine's +3/+3 now needs a new host, ending free back-and-forth swaps.
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 8 distinct and settled, but ranked third of three; for players who love arranging boards around another tribe's carry.
